_confidenceBandComment: mappingConfidence is written by the forge from the judge's pick confidence (educoreForge configs jevJudge.ini: strongMinConfidence 0.8, moderateMinConfidence 0.5). Measured on GOLD_261106_useCases: 0.9 carries judgePickConfidence 0.80-1.00, 0.7 carries 0.50-0.79, 0.5 carries 0.15-0.49.

confidenceBandList.meaningText: the judge's own confidence in its pick was 0.8 or more
the judge's confidence was 0.5 to under 0.8

_mappingOriginComment: how much is publisher-stated, machine-proposed or human-reviewed, read from mappingKind on each edge. A kind not listed here is refused by name.

mappingOriginList.meaningText: the standard's own published document names the hub element (matchBasis declaredIdentity)
an AI judge chose the hub card from ranked candidates (matchBasis derived)

humanReviewedNoteText: No edge in the graph records a human review: the graph's vocabulary has no such mapping kind yet. Human judgments are kept apart, in the CEDS Rater's store, and are compared with the graph in the agreement section.

humanJudgment._comment: The CEDS Rater's sample is drawn for the CEDS hub only, so every human-agreement figure is a CEDS-hub figure. hubName names the hub the graph's answer is read from.
humanJudgment._graphFamilyComment: the sample names its standards by family; a certificate shows the family's pooled human figures and says they are pooled
humanJudgment._drawSourceComment: which graph sources the sample drew each standard from, read from the rater tool's raterDraw.json by these field names; a standard with no field here was drawn from every source of its family

_priorMeasurementComment: Earlier measurements, cited with their date, build and source so a reader can tell them from this report's own figures. They measured EARLIER builds and judge configurations, never this graph; the report never presents them as this graph's accuracy.

priorMeasurementList.measuredWhatText: Ed-Fi to CEDS, property tier: the AI judge, run blind, against Ed-Fi's own published CEDS crosswalk, on the 65 sampled Ed-Fi elements that crosswalk maps
